summary: Add unwired shared sidebar projection for v2 live ordered memberships

schema.detail: Uses existing arrangement and ordered-membership schema types; extends only shared behavior fixtures.

compatibility.detail: Hosts remain on v1. The new pure v2 entry point requires a complete live membership set with server-effective positions and complete resolved folder ancestry. It never appends remembered catalog members or guesses retirement and lift.

manual.detail: No deployment action or migration required.
